title: %pow - raise base to an exponent
purpose: Raise a base to an exponent (e.g. a growth factor over n periods).
notes: 1.05^10 is the ten-period growth factor for a 5% rate.
Output is a TS shortest-round-trip float (last-digit f64 differs cross-language); verified in TS only.

avoid.why: %pow needs both base and exponent; one argument yields ~ (null)
